name: Class B Residence Permit (Employed Expatriates)

requirements.blocker_text: An employment contract including a repatriation clause is required, along with professional registration certificates (where applicable), company documentation, a CV, five photographs, and immigration status verification. Applicants must apply from outside Tanzania.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a specialized-skills employment contract (with repatriation clause) from a Tanzanian employer, then apply from outside Tanzania.

outcome.duration_length: not specified precisely; USD 1,500 per issuance and renewal

sources.title: Embassy of Tanzania, Washington D.C. -- official description of Class B residence/work permits for employed expatriates with specialized skills in companies, public corporations, fishing, mining, and transportation sectors; requires an employment contract with repatriation clause; USD 1,500 per issuance/renewal; must apply from outside Tanzania; dependents (spouse and children under 18) may be endorsed on the permit

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Tanzania). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct official-embassy sourcing, tier 1. work_rights set 'restricted' since the permit is tied to a specific employer/role and sector (specialized skills only, not open labor-market access). family_can_work set false -- the source confirms dependents may be endorsed on the permit for residence but does not state they gain independent work rights.
